hero.title: Turning Ideas Into Engineered Systems.
hero.text: Rynia Studios is an independent developer studio crafting software, digital products, and interactive systems. Approaching every project—including games—with the same engineering discipline and patience.

origin.label: 02 — Origin
origin.title: From a Nickname to a Developer Studio.
origin.p1: Rynia didn't begin with deep or mystical meanings. Around 2019, it started simply from a search for a nickname that would fit naturally and stay with me for years. Over time, in every server, project, and community, my identity became Rynia.
origin.p2: I later learned it was the name of a village in Poland, but for me it was never a location—it was my digital identity forged across years online. When founding Rynia Studios, carrying this name was natural: it reminds me never to leave things unfinished, to build patiently layer by layer, and to evolve step by step. What started as a simple online handle has now transformed into the name of an independent studio where I build software, digital products, and games.

vision.label: 03 — Vision & Mission
vision.title: Discipline, Systems, Sustainability.
vision.visionText: To establish an impactful independent studio by engineering focused, well-architected, and enduring digital products and software systems.
vision.missionText: To design manageable and scalable digital systems while relentlessly refining our engineering standards, creative workflows, and production efficiency.

products.label: 04 — Products & Systems
products.title: Our Digital Products.
products.subtitle: Focused software solving real-world friction.
products.kilerDescription: Snap a photo of your fridge or scan your groceries; the system identifies expiring items, prevents waste, and outputs an optimized 15-minute rescue recipe.

games.label: 05 — Game Development
games.title: We Build Games Too.
games.subtitle: Alongside digital tools and software, we engineer interactive game systems.
games.komboDescription: Kombo Kart is a mobile auto-battler card game built around drafting, card evolution, positioning, and elemental synergies.
games.protocolDescription: An early-stage, multi-platform concept exploring complex systems and narrative depth. Details will surface as the design takes shape.
